Product Details: Solar Panel Mounting Structure for 2 Panels (200-300W Shark Panels) | Supports 1 Panel 500-790W | Adjustable GI Rooftop Solar Stand DIY Kit - Distributed/Packaged by Solarware. Product Details: Solarware introduces a heavy-duty solar panel mounting structure designed for rooftop and flat roof installations. This structure is engineered to support two solar panels of 200W–300W each in landscape orientation, such as Loom Solar Shark panels. It can also support one large solar panel of 500W–790W or higher capacity, depending on the panel dimensions. The mounting stand is built using high-quality galvanized iron (GI) with a durable corrosion-resistant finish, ensuring a long outdoor life of 30–40 years. The structure uses 41×41mm U-channel rails, providing excellent strength and stability for rooftop solar installations. The stand features an adjustable tilt design that allows you to position solar panels towards the South or SSE direction to maximize solar energy generation throughout the year. This solar mounting stand is ideal for small off-grid solar power systems, including battery charging setups, solar backup systems, EV bike charging, and small home solar installations using inverters such as UTL Gamma Lion, Sunlion or UTL SunPlus Pro series. The structure is supplied as a DIY installation kit, including rafters, legs, base plates, clamps, and fasteners required for assembly. Proper cement concrete foundation blocks or rooftop anchors should be used to ensure structural stability and safety. Solar panels and electrical equipment are not included with this product.
